challenges.says: Criteria 2 and 3 (orphaned parent with disabled button, top-level shows nothing) state exactly what businessrule-88550832449331267612 says but cite no rule (from is empty) and give no reason, so the rule's other two conditions are left uncited.

The story promises to reach any parent 'at any level, without climbing one step at a time' and to show the policies the category holds, yet criterion 4 has the person climb one parent at a time and no criterion or cited rule states the policies list or an at-once ancestry chain, so the title/what/why claim behaviour no rule or action states.

Criterion 4 ('keep going up until a top-level category or a missing parent is reached') and the 'from a policy in it' opening path are only partly carried by the action blocks and rule, and with from empty and no stated reason it reads as invented behaviour.
